purpose: Descriptive allocation and live-memory diagnostic for adopted DOCX section-layout base retention with larger inventories and multiple simultaneously live commits.
claim_scope: No latency, speedup, allocation-saving, or adoption claim. Whole-process RSS and child wall time are setup-inclusive context only.

source.source_binding: measurement-source-final receipt + regenerated byte-identical full listing + source-closure addendum v3
source.production_scope: current adopted DOCX retention implementation at the base revision
source.required_custody: Bind the exact source listing, diagnostic patch, Cargo lock/manifests, compiler/profile/features, and final source/build receipts before capture.

matrix.order: section count, commit count, policy, ownership, repetition; no adaptive reordering or recapture

retention_admission.exact_cap: required_retained_base_bytes measured by the bounded probe
retention_admission.preflight: Require positive measured base weight and verify zero, one-under, exact, and default boundary outcomes for every section shape before authorization.

lifecycle.hold: Keep all requested commits live simultaneously after source packages/snapshot owners are released according to the topology.
lifecycle.release_order: release the first N-1 commits in insertion order, then the final commit, then drop the vector; every policy records the same release/drop journal

topology_controls.shared_snapshot_clones: one source package and one base snapshot cloned into each edit; every inventory pair must share its Arc allocations
topology_controls.independent_sources: one independently opened OwnedSource/package/snapshot per commit; no inventory pair may share its Arc allocations

measurements.logical: per-commit retained_base_bytes and their sum; this excludes XML, allocator bookkeeping, and physical RSS
measurements.allocator: allocation/deallocation/reallocation calls, requested allocated/deallocated bytes, live bytes before/after, peak live bytes, and region peak from the isolated counting allocator
measurements.process: whole-child /usr/bin/time -v RSS and maximum RSS, labeled setup-inclusive and distinct from allocator live bytes
measurements.correctness: exact output bytes, reopened section shape, inverse-restored source bytes, source hash, and Arc-sharing topology must pass before a row is accepted

runner.packet_policy: All reports, logs, binaries, source listings, and receipts remain under the external root; only reduced sub-megabyte summaries and tooling enter the repository.
runner.child_process: fresh process group per matrix row, taskset CPU 12, allowlisted child environment, original terminal receipt written before report parsing, process-group closure polled, no retries or selective recapture
runner.replay_custody: Rehash the frozen binary, source receipt, build receipt, and every external custody descriptor on replay; also rehash the copied packet runner and require its descriptor to equal the manifest runner hash.
runner.approval: capture requires a final authorized manifest and LITCHI_PERF_0931_CAPTURE_APPROVED=1; this plan is not capture authorization
runner.checkpoint_schema: Scalar per-child summaries only; checkpoint-NNN files are immutable and the final state conserves their ordered child IDs. Raw report vectors are never duplicated into state files.

report_contract.reducer: Validate cap policy, ownership topology, checkpoint conservation, source identity, exact packet members, copied-script/build/source descriptors, allocator flags/peaks/balances, and every hold/release phase before producing descriptive per-cell medians and raw scalar samples.

preflight.prelight_scope: Exactly two one-process prelights: sections 16 and 8192, commits 1, exact policy, shared_snapshot_clones; no formal 96-child rows.
preflight.wrapper_note: The prelight wrapper exited 1 after both child terminal/report records were written because its post-run display lookup used a missing top-level sections key; no child was retried.
